entities.summary: All India Institute of Ayurveda, abbreviated as AIIA, is a public Ayurveda medicine and research institution located in New Delhi, India. The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA) is an apex autonomous body under the Ministry of Ayush, established to serve as a center of excellence for the traditional Indian medical system of Ayurveda. The theory and practice of ayurveda is pseudoscientific.
